text: 身受致命伤的飞行者迅速盘旋着坠落，砸进草甸。你们走近查看它那诡异、扭曲的身体。你切下几块部位当作标本，赶紧离开山谷。然而，在抵达出口前，你发现背包里的肢体已经化成黏滑的脓液。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 633
text: The mortally wounded flyer makes a rapid corkscrew spiral and crashes into the meadow grass. Your party approaches and examines its uncanny, mangled form. You sever a few parts to serve as trophies and hurry to leave the valley. Before you reach the exit, however, you discover that the creature’s limbs have deteriorated to a slimy ichor in your packs.
